description:
Hushfeed v0.51.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Remove feed ads now catches location-affiliate videos marked Creator earns commission, including posts without standard ad flags or shopping data. It uses TikTok's native disclosure marker before feed delivery, so it doesn't depend on English text. Ordinary location tags aren't enough to remove a post. Paid partnerships and branded content are also covered, with the related controls grouped under Ads.

Keeping only For You hides its redundant top title and underline while leaving Search available. App settings can hide the purple rewards shortcut on Profile through Hide floating promotions. That optional control is off by default.

Validation: 1486 runtime tests passed locally, plus 247 patch tests. Both Android lint checks passed. The bundle carries 91 patches and all three nonempty DEX payloads. All 91 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with no unexpected manifest changes. Older fixtures are compatibility checks; 47.0.3 remains the supported install target.

The exact release-derived APK was installed over the same-signer build on the S22 and matches the installed pull byte for byte. Both reported commission examples are removed by the real ad-filter boundary and patched native feed getter with filtering on, and kept with it off. An ordinary-video control stays available. Settings were restored, and fresh feed checks passed. This doesn't claim every server-delivered disclosure variant has been encountered. The signed-in account and original first-install time were preserved. The exact new build wasn't installed on the S25 because its existing signing key differs. No app data was removed.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. The downloadable .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
